suite: v26 production targets and scheduled physical supply

results.name: Sector stock target stops all producers at shared coverage and resumes below low
Target hysteresis does not restart for a small stock decrease
Active high-food batch completes even after lowering the stock target
Completed output is still transported while target holding
Manual pause remains paused after production target removal
Target prevents new input and remote relay requests for held recipe
Target respects sector boundaries and does not suppress a second region
Reserved export is removed from local coverage; receipt is not double counted
Target diagnostics and resource inspector are read-only
Malformed target, owner, and resource commands have no side effects
Bulk shipment splits complete quantity into capacity-limited real jobs
Bulk shortage rejects entire request with zero partial reservations
Bulk destination capacity failure is atomic
Repeated replenishment fills exactly the target and restarts after consumption
Source reserve bounds this rule export without creating goods
Two rules sharing a source cannot double reserve remaining stock
Destination already inbound manual shipments suppress duplicate auto orders
Same destination and resource updates existing rule rather than duplicating it
Two-node and three-node same-resource supply cycles are rejected atomically
Opposite direction for different resources remains allowed
Disabled reverse policy cannot be reenabled into a cycle
Disabling releases unpicked first-leg reservations
Disabling an already loaded order preserves cargo and completes delivery
Two-hop handoff completes after policy disable at intermediate warehouse
Road closure creates explicit wait and resumes without dropped reservations
Captured destination disables policies and clears stale production target
Destination full waits; expanded capacity permits later scheduled dispatch
Operations survive in-flight save with exact deterministic continuation
Actual v25 snapshot migrates preserving in-flight agents, stocks and jobs
Save rejects invalid thresholds, duplicate policies, injected resources and missing rule refs
Save rejects cycles independently of command validation
Resource inspector exposes live producers, inputs and exact outgoing reservations
Long-run four-route economy with active targets preserves conservation at every minute
